notes.title: Magirune 2 Available
notes.content:
For those that like the original Magirune. This is to let you know that Magirune 2 is available on steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677020/Magirune_2/

notes.title: Magirune is out!
notes.content:
Magirune is now on steam. Combining the love of two of my favorite games, I am proud to show you my first game and I hope you will like it. Might not be as awesome as those AAA games out there but I'm sure you will have fun.

Can you finish hardcore mode? The way the game was meant to be played.
